title: Fibre-product stalk is flat over the tensor of stalks
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $z\in X\times_S T$ [def-pc-base-change] have projections $x,t$ and common image $s$. Put $R=\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $A=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $B=\mathcal O_{T,t}$, $C=\mathcal O_{X\times_S T,z}$. Give $A$ and $B$ their $R$-algebra structures via the scheme stalk maps, transporting the latter along $f(x)=g(t)$. Give $C$ its $A\otimes_R B$-algebra structure whose restrictions to $A$ and $B$ are the two projection stalk maps. Then $C$ is flat over $A\otimes_R B$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

proof.text: Use the proved upstream instance Scheme.flat_fromSpecStalk from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Flat. Its affine-open instance factors the canonical local-ring morphism through Spec of the germ localization followed by an open immersion: IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk and IsLocalization.flat give flatness of the germ map, Flat.SpecMap_iff gives flatness on spectra, and Flat.comp gives the composite. The scheme instance uses the affine cover containing the point. No private copy of this theorem is needed.

Put R=O(S,s), A=O(X,x), B=O(T,t), C=O(X times_S T,z). Use hRA and hRB and Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk to make the two commutative squares of canonical maps Spec A -> X, Spec B -> T, Spec R -> S. The stalkCongr transport in hRB is handled by spec_stalkCongr_fromSpecStalk, proved by eliminating the point equality. The tensor pushout, CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct, gives the pullback square of Spec(A tensor_R B) over Spec R via isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout.

The three canonical maps from spectra of stalks are preimmersions by Mathlib Stalk, hence monomorphisms. Let m be the induced pullback.map between the two pullbacks. Rewrite m with pullback_map_eq_pullbackFstFstIso_inv: because Spec R -> S is mono, m is an isomorphism followed by two projections which are base changes of the preimmersions Spec A -> X and Spec B -> T. Stability of preimmersions under base change and composition makes m a preimmersion. Composing m with the tensor pullback isomorphism gives a preimmersion, hence mono, k:Spec(A tensor_R B) -> X times_S T. This is implemented by the fully proved private helper preimmersion_pullback_map and hk.

Let j:Spec C -> Spec(A tensor_R B) be the spectrum of the stipulated algebra map. Prove j followed by k equals the canonical map Spec C -> X times_S T by pullback.hom_ext. On the first projection use hAC, on the second hBC; in each case Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk gives the desired equality after Spec.map_comp and the pullback isomorphism projection equations. Thus j followed by k is flat by the first step.

Since k is mono and j followed by k is flat, j is flat: the square with top id on Spec C, bottom k, left j and right j followed by k is cartesian, because cancellation of k gives its universal property. Apply flat base-change stability, implemented by MorphismProperty.of_postcomp with monomorphisms. Finally Flat.SpecMap_iff and RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff identify flatness of j with Module.Flat (A tensor_R B) C for exactly the given algebra structure.

lean.statement:
theorem pullback_stalk_tensor_flat
    {S T X : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : X ⟶ S)
    (x' : ↥(pullback f g))
    [Algebra (S.presheaf.stalk (f ((pullback.fst f g) x'))) (X.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.fst f g)
      x'))] [Algebra (S.presheaf.stalk (f ((pullback.fst f g) x'))) (T.presheaf.stalk
      ((pullback.snd f g) x'))] [Algebra ((X.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.fst f g) x'))
      ⊗[(S.presheaf.stalk (f ((pullback.fst f g) x')))] (T.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.snd f g)
      x'))) ((pullback f g).presheaf.stalk x')]
    (hRA : algebraMap (S.presheaf.stalk (f ((pullback.fst f g) x'))) (X.presheaf.stalk
      ((pullback.fst f g) x')) = (f.stalkMap ((pullback.fst f g) x')).hom)
    (hRB : algebraMap (S.presheaf.stalk (f ((pullback.fst f g) x'))) (T.presheaf.stalk
      ((pullback.snd f g) x')) =
      (g.stalkMap ((pullback.snd f g) x')).hom.comp (S.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq
        (congrArg (fun φ : pullback f g ⟶ S => φ x') pullback.condition))).hom.hom)
    (hAC : (algebraMap ((X.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.fst f g) x')) ⊗[(S.presheaf.stalk (f
      ((pullback.fst f g) x')))] (T.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.snd f g) x'))) ((pullback f
      g).presheaf.stalk x')).comp (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.fst f g) x'))
      ((X.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.fst f g) x')) ⊗[(S.presheaf.stalk (f ((pullback.fst f g)
      x')))] (T.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.snd f g) x')))) =
      ((pullback.fst f g).stalkMap x').hom)
    (hBC : (algebraMap ((X.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.fst f g) x')) ⊗[(S.presheaf.stalk (f
      ((pullback.fst f g) x')))] (T.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.snd f g) x'))) ((pullback f
      g).presheaf.stalk x')).comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom =
        ((pullback.snd f g).stalkMap x').hom)
    : Module.Flat
      ((X.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.fst f g) x'))
        ⊗[S.presheaf.stalk (f ((pullback.fst f g) x'))]
        (T.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.snd f g) x')))
      ((pullback f g).presheaf.stalk x')
